title: CI never runs lore check, so the repo's stated docs gate has never gated — and it is red on dev right now
summary: The fleet operating rule is 'lore check exiting 0 is the definition of done for a docs change', but no job in .github/workflows runs it. Measured on dev at effd5dea: lore check exits 6. Cause: LCLI-333 carries status 'Blocked', which is outside quest's configured status flow (To Do / In Progress / Done, paused: Paused). It is the only off-flow record of 437. A gate nothing runs is a gate that silently stopped gating.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A CI job runs lore check on every PR and its exit code gates the merge
LCLI-333's off-flow status is resolved — either moved into the configured flow, or given a [reconcile.overrides] entry in .lore/config.toml with the reason recorded
The new job is added to dev's required status checks, matched by rendered job name verified by codepoint, so it actually blocks rather than merely reporting
